tools.name: Export glTF/GLB
tools.description: Re-exports the active scene to a self-contained .glb file. Enables the bundled glTF add-on if needed.

tools.name: Export USD
tools.description: Opens a downloaded Blendkit .blend, unpacks its packed textures, flattens shader node groups and exports a self-contained UsdPreviewSurface .usd file. Optionally also emits standalone MaterialX (.mtlx) materials plus a name-keyed mapping JSON alongside the .usd.

params.name: max_resolution
params.description: Texture resolution cap: 512/1024/2048/4096/8192/ORIGINAL. Picks the textures subfolder suffix.

params.name: export_mtlx
params.description: Also export one standalone .mtlx per material into <stem>_mtlx/ and write <stem>.materials.json mapping material names to their .mtlx files (for high-fidelity material binding in Maya/USD). Requires the MaterialX Python module bundled with Blender 4.1+; skipped gracefully if unavailable.

params.name: normal_map_target
params.description: Normal-map handling: preserve for standard MaterialX, directx for encoded green-channel conversion, or unreal for Unreal's signed normal sampling and explicit normal/bump blending. USD records convention metadata and native Preview Surface scale/bias decoding.
